text:
ana: Heads-up: customer requested per-route cost attribution + low-overhead trace hooks in Console to map SLO regressions to dollars. I sketched MVP and launch checks below. Feedback?
mike: Sounds good. Lay out the canary thresholds?
sasha: Storage note: full traces for all requests is untenable. Default sampling + error/anomaly always-on. Propose defaults and retention.
praveen: Implementation plan: pre-sample before serialization, async WAL, compact proto envelope. Keep dataplane CPU overhead <10%.
joan: Product constraints: RBAC on cost views, CSV export for finance, PII redaction + KMS tagging for Private. These are GA blockers for regulated customers.
nana: (typo  ana) MVP scope: route token meter, model-variant cost calc, adaptive sampling (errors+anomalies), route dashboard template, RBAC + redaction toggle.
mike: Canary: 5% traffic x 48h -> 20% x 72h. Monitor per-route p50/p95, cost-per-1k, error-rate. Success if latency regressions <5% and error uplift <0.2pp and cost variance <15%.
sasha: Retention suggestion: full traces 14d, aggregates 90d. Default sampling 0.05% with route overrides. Need compression/dedupe.
praveen: Draft sampling config we can expose:
```yaml
sampling:
  default: 0.0005
  routes:
    "/v1/generate": 0.005
    "/v1/chat": 0.001
  rules:
    on_error: 1.0
    on_cost_anomaly: 1.0
```
mike: I'll prototype the canary dashboard and temporary alerts.
observability-bot: created issue #4720 "console: per-route-cost + trace-hooks MVP" and assigned to @ana @mike @praveen. https://github.com/redwood-inference/observability/issues/4720
joan: Priority: top-10 customer ask; recommend P0 for next quarter. Next steps: Mike dash proto (Tue), Praveen perf sim (Wed), Sasha cost model (Fri), Joan vignette + RBAC checklist (5 days). I'll schedule 30m sync after artifacts land.
